beats.text: Rent in Manitoba? There's a credit on your tax return you don't want to miss.
And for twenty twenty-six, it went up.
The Renters Affordability Tax Credit: up to six hundred twenty-five dollars for the twenty twenty-six tax year. For twenty twenty-five, it was up to five seventy-five.
You need to live in Manitoba on December thirty-first, be at least sixteen, and pay rent on your main home here.
Moved during the year? You claim the months you rented.
Eligible seniors can also get a top-up of up to three hundred fifty-seven dollars.
You claim it on form MB four seventy-nine with your return, so keep your rent records.
File your return, fill in the form, and get what's yours.
